reviews.title: Not enough value for subscription or free
reviews.text: I only need for occasional use and willing to pay the fee when doing 1 or 2 days of volunteer work so I can add more than 10 addresses. However, the update locking the ability to mark delivery status behind a second paywall broke the functionality of the app. I wasted more time trying to get it to automatically recognize visited addresses that were floated on the same street and missing turns because the navigation was too slow for real time. Ended up ditching the app halfway through the route and doing it manually because otherwise I’d have to drive back to addresses I already visited since there was no way I could figure out how to mark off or skip - it just kept (slowly) recalculating. Also, as a navigation app, it absolutely needs a CarPlay app so you can see it.

reviews.title: Used it for years, recent update lost all functionality
reviews.text: I am very bummed because I’ve been an advocate for Route4Me in my sales org for years. I decided to pay more for an upgrade, and when that happened all the functionality I liked it for was gone. You used to be able to import an excel with addresses from the web (no I did not have a corporate account). Reached out to customer service and they aren’t helping fix or solve the problem at all, just telling me to pay more to upgrade to a different version. I used to pay $9.99 for the past 5 years, did an upgrade for $199 in December and lost my web capabilities and now they are asking me to pay for a web based membership on top of that. If you have the legacy version do not pay to upgrade!
